day_shape: 89 items dominated by the US-Iran 14-point MoU (oil sales resume on signing, Israel unmentioned), E4+ leaders' statement backing the deal, Trump criticising Israel's Hezbollah war, IDF strikes near Nabatieh killing four, and heavy Khamenei-funeral messaging on regime channels.

threads.label: US-Iran MoU terms and reactions
threads.summary: The Wall Street Journal and Al Arabiya reported the 14-point US-Iran Memorandum of Understanding permits immediate Iranian oil, banking, transport and insurance sales on signing, with Israel unmentioned in the draft. Trump defended the deal at the G7, Vance said he was 'confident' Israel would join with talks set for Friday, and Israeli figures including Liberman and Minister Zohar criticised it.

threads.label: UK, E4 and Pakistan endorse deal
threads.summary: The UK published a joint E4 Leaders' Statement of 14 June, signed by the UK, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, Canada, Australia and over 20 other states, backing the US-Iran peace deal. The FCDO also marked Pakistan's role in brokering the agreement during a two-day ministerial visit on migration.

threads.label: Lebanon strikes and Trump-Hezbollah remarks
threads.summary: Lebanon's NNA reported four killed in successive Israeli drone strikes near Nabatieh, while the IDF said it intercepted Hezbollah rockets in southern Lebanon and destroyed the launcher; Defa Press claimed 84 ceasefire violations in two days. Trump said Israel's war on Hezbollah was 'too long, too deadly' and suggested Syria should take on the group instead.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and Iran-Oman coordination
threads.summary: IRIB cited a CNN report that US intelligence assessed Iran capable of effectively blocking the Strait of Hormuz at will. Foreign Ministers Araghchi and Badr al-Busaidi discussed maritime security and the Islamabad MoU by phone, while Times of Israel reported the US has used Iranian-style smuggling tactics to move Gulf oil past the blockade.

threads.label: Iran executions and Pahlavi response
threads.summary: Iran executed Javad Zamani and Abolqasem (Abolfazl) Saedi over the January Shahrud protests, with Defa Press and IRIB publishing 'confession' material naming Crown Prince Reza Pahlavi. Pahlavi separately denounced the upcoming US-Iran MoU as 'morally wrong and strategically misguided', and Naftali Bennett said he had drawn up a plan to help Iranians topple the Islamic Republic.

threads.label: Khamenei funeral messaging and unity calls
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB ran Statement No. 4 of the headquarters for the 'farewell of Iran's Martyr Leader' Khamenei, designating 'Must rise up' as the slogan and 'the clenched fist' as the official emblem. Khamenei's office posted excerpts calling on Iranians not to turn differences into conflict, echoed by First Vice President Arif.

threads.label: Yemen at the Security Council
threads.summary: The UN Security Council held its 10174th meeting on Yemen, with Special Envoy Hans Grundberg and Under-Secretary-General Tom Fletcher briefing. UK Minister Counsellor Jennifer MacNaughtan said the UK had provided over $190m towards Yemen's humanitarian response.
